_comment: Guppy, the ship's AI, drawn as a pixel portrait. The books describe him as looking like Admiral Ackbar, which is a Star Wars character we can't reproduce — so this is built from the description rather than the reference: an amphibious humanoid with a broad cranium, wide-set eyes and gill slits. The expression is deliberately flat. The text keeps returning to his fishy poker face, and it is the joke: Guppy is the one being in the series with nothing to prove.
_palette_note: Values are fill-opacity against currentColor, so one portrait works wherever it is placed — phosphor green on the boot screen, amber in a dossier — without a second copy. The eyes are near-transparent on purpose: on a dark panel that reads as a socket rather than a painted-on dot.
